title: Chapter 85 Containment
content:
Chapter 85 Containment

(Wall asking for recommendation votes)

"one two three four."

Half an hour later, in the house of a farmer with jujube trees in Libei.

Heifu counted a few women sitting together and asked Li Zheng, who was tied to a pillar by Wuhua Da, "Are these four the only women in Feng Li Zheng and Blind Mountain who were robbed and sold by human traffickers?"

Feng's hair and beard were still stained with coagulated chicken blood, and he looked very embarrassed. He turned his head away angrily, unwilling to answer.

Tian Dian, who was still a little timid at the side, quickly responded: "Pavilion Chief, there are still a few people, but they have been bought for a long time and they no longer want to go home..."

Heifu nodded. This is human nature. Over time, the desire to leave has faded away. It is Ju's daughter "Yuan Yuan" and the woman Ji Ying and the others found who was locked up in a pig pen and abused. He resisted and tried to escape again and again.

It turned out that just after Heifu and Dongmen Bao restrained Li Zheng and Tian Dian, they immediately took them as hostages and forced the residents who came after hearing the news to get out of the way until they reached the place where the whistle sounded in the north.

Li Xian, Ji Ying and Ju, together with a rescued woman, were being besieged by three men from the farmer's family and their neighbors. Dongmen Leopard roared again and shouted them back, and everyone in Huyang Pavilion was able to join together.

Heifu had people close the courtyard door and used this farmer's house as a temporary base. He also used Li Zheng and Tian Dian as threats to ask the residents outside to quickly bring in the other women who had been robbed and sold!

Everyone in Blind Mountain was basically the descendant of a Pu tribe in the past. Li Zheng and Tian Dian were both officials and clan leaders. Li Zheng refused to cooperate. Fortunately, Tian Dian did as Heifu said. After a while, two more people A woman was sent over.

At that time, Heifu planned to take his people and leave Blind Mountain quickly, but he was blocked back by the inner wall.

In order to unite everyone and rescue the people who were kidnapped and sold, they were still a step too late. The third person in the prison gate had already heard the news and rushed to organize the people inside to surround them.

Under the organization of the inner prison gate, the originally scattered inner residents outside began to gather more and more, each holding farm tools, and surrounded the farmhouse. They neither dared to rush in, but refused to give up the road. Both sides It's such a stalemate.

Heifu asked Dongmen Bao and Li Xian to guard the outside with spears and crossbows respectively. He and Ji Ying were inside and asked about the experiences of the four women. Now that they can't get out for the time being, they can only grasp the basic situation. , Only by understanding the criminal situation of the officials and people in Blind Mountain can he make the next plan.

So, starting with Ju's daughter Yuanyuan, the four women who were kidnapped and sold into the blind mountain began to make tearful accusations...

…

Yuan Yuan is only 16 years old, but due to the pain of the past two years, she is a little haggard and does not look like a young girl.

She said that in March two years ago, when she went to pick mulberries, she was greeted by an old woman passing by. The old woman was in her fifties and had a kind face. She also chatted with her and kept praising Yuan Yuan. Beauty. Then she said that her relatives were waiting for her behind Sang Lin. She couldn't walk. Could Yuanyuan help her there?

Yuanyuan had no doubt that he was there, but what was waiting for her behind Sang Lin was two big men over seven feet tall. They put sacks on her head, strangled her and threw her into the car...

In the days that followed, she was half-conscious, her mouth was gagged, and she was not allowed to eat to prevent her from escaping. She was sent to the blind mountain in a bumpy state. When her hood was taken off, she was already sitting in Li Zheng's home. Li Zheng said that she had been sold as a concubine and from now on she would be the wife of Li Zheng's stupid brother. …

Life in the Li Zheng family was not too bad to be honest, but Yuanyuan always remembered her parents, and

I couldn't bear to serve that stupid "husband", so I tried to escape many times in the past two years, but I was caught every time by Rimasa's men.

As Yuanyuan spoke, she looked at Li Zheng with gritted teeth, because Li Zheng's stupid brother didn't know anything about men and women. That night, Li Zheng actually demonstrated in person, teaching him step by step how to have sex with Yuan Yuan, and then violated him several times. she.

She had been doted on by her parents since she was a child, but she had never suffered such humiliation. She once tried to hang herself to death, but was saved again. For two years, life was worse than death...

Having said this, she threw herself into her father's arms again and burst into tears. This sixteen-year-old girl had already experienced the greatest pain in the world.

However, her experience is nothing compared to the woman called "Ling" who was locked up in the pig pen...

Ying was a little mentally disturbed after being locked up for a long time. The dirt on her body had been cleaned off by others, and Hei Fu even used his own clothes to cover her body. But no matter what I asked, she would just giggle and repeat words such as "I was robbed and sold", "Help", "Spare my life".

Therefore, Heifu and others could only learn about her from the other three women's narrations.

Yuanyuan said: "She was robbed and sold three years ago. She was sold to the three brothers in Libei for more than a thousand yuan, and she was made their wife at the same time..."

Polyandry, this appalling custom that disregards human ethics, is not the only one in Blind Mountain. Another woman also cried and said that she was the wife of a father and son at the same time...

Ying was the one who resisted the most fiercely among the women who were kidnapped and sold. After all, this kind of life of serving three brothers at the same time was unacceptable to most people. But like Yuanyuan, every time she escaped ended in failure, and the three brothers were very cruel. Every time they caught her, they would beat her severely and lock her in a dark room and starve her for several days. Ji Ying was I accidentally bumped into her then.

In the end, he simply closed the pig pen, and from then on, Ying began to become crazy.

After these women finished speaking, Ji Ying was so angry that he kicked Li Zheng several times before Hei Fu could take action. He had several sisters in his family who were about the same age as Ying and Yuanyuan, so it was inevitable that they would be angry.

"Whose sister is not a sister, and whose daughter is not a daughter, you are really capable of doing this! As a local official, you don't care about such a tragic incident, and you take the lead in buying it! It's really a beast! Although I, Ji Ying, am not a good person. , but can’t do such a thing!”

Na Zheng turned his head and sneered: "What else? There are many men in Blind Mountain, and it is far away from other places. Women from other places are not willing to marry here, and there are not enough women in this place, so we can only buy them from outside." , what else can be done!”

This is the reason why people from top to bottom in Blind Mountain are so keen on buying robbed and sold women. The original good people turned into evil people just because of the instinct of procreation.

Of course, the slave trade was legal these days, and they could also buy concubines, but an adult concubine cost more than four thousand dollars. Blind Mountain was so poor that several families couldn't raise so much money. At this time, human traffickers came to the door. The women they provided were not only young, but also only cost one or two thousand yuan each!

Li Zheng was speaking plausibly and seemed to be reasonable, but Yuanyuan angrily slapped him in the face and cursed: "Don't make excuses here. I heard from the old man Li Zhong that it was not because a baby girl was born in Blind Mountain." He just likes to drown! You deserve to be in the situation you are in today. I curse your entire clan to be exterminated! Bah!"

She spat and straightened her face, and then Hei Fu asked Ju to pull her back.

In this way, what happened in Blind Mountain became clear. Although the people here did not directly participate in the robbery and trafficking, they knew that there was something wrong with the women, but they still bought them from traffickers many times. This has been going on for more than ten years, and there have been ten people in succession. Several women were sold here by the same group of people.

But except for the four people in front of them, most of the others accepted their fate, or felt that marrying was not a marriage. Now that they had the hope of being rescued, they silently chose to give up.

Or maybe it's because they gave birth to children here and couldn't let go.

At this time, Na Tiandian was already asking Heifu, what crime would he be punished for since he had never purchased the victims?

"Whether you are involved or not, as long as you know and fail to report it, you will be punished! Being a city official is a sure thing, but as a local official, you are guilty of an extra level of crime, and you will be punished with a tattoo!"

Li Zheng, with red eyes, stated the crime, and then sneered: "As for those of us who knew these women were not legitimate but still bought them, we are guilty of the same crime as those who plunder and sell people, and are subject to death!"

"It seems you still know?"

Heifu sneered, it seems that this is exactly what he asked someone to know about.

Indeed, in the Qin laws, human trafficking is the same crime as rape and rape, and both are punished by being beaten, quartered and abandoned in the market!

As long as it is a buyer who has prior knowledge, he is also guilty of the same crime. A buyer who does not know in advance will be tattooed as a Chengdan pound, and others who help conceal it will have their toes chopped off as a Chengdan pound...

In Qin, the punishments are so severe and the crimes are so serious! Contrary to the later generations of "whoever buys abducted women or children shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or surveillance", and "whoever does not abuse the children who are bought and does not hinder their rescue, they may not be held criminally responsible" The gentle regulations are completely different!

Although this kind of severe punishment for trafficking makes Heifu feel relieved, it also has a problem, that is, if the offender knows that he will die, he will fight tooth and nail...

"It's a bit difficult for us to get out of the blind mountain safely today..."

Heifu opened the window. Outside the fence of this farmer's house, it was completely surrounded. Almost all of the more than two hundred people in the house, regardless of gender, old or young, were gathered here. They were holding farm tools, and their faces were dark and equally dark. His eyes were full of evil.

More than two thousand years of history have gone in a circle, and there will always be a sudden intersection at a certain moment or event. This scene seems familiar...
